checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: All four lines spoken exactly as supplied, in order
must.why: The delivered script had three different lines (book dialogue), not the four supplied lines about tickets.

must.item: Two distinguishable voices, A lower and B higher
must.why: Man and woman are visible, but the audio can't be judged.

must.item: Each voice reads its assigned lines
must.why: The script had three lines, not four, so the A/B/A/B pattern isn't met.

must.item: Friendly, natural, about 8 s, no overlap or cutoffs
must.why: Length is 8 s and the mood looks friendly, but the speech can't be checked.

must.item: Standalone audio file with no music or SFX
must.why: It is an MP4 video with a café scene and the agent asked for café background sounds.

exact_text.read_as: No text on screen; the script used was 'Did you finish the book I gave you?'

exact_text.text: Almost. Have you got the tickets?

faults.what: Wrong script: the dialogue about a book was used instead of the supplied four lines.
Delivered as an MP4 video with picture, not a standalone audio file.
Café ambience was added, though the must-haves say no sound effects.
The woman's pose and the camera framing shift at the end, a slight change from the earlier frames.

summary: The output is an 8 s video of a man and woman in a café, not a standalone audio file, and it used a different script with added café ambience instead of the four supplied lines.
